description: This Java source file defines the 'EmailTemplatesUtils' utility class which provides various methods for sending different types of email notifications (order confirmation, registration, contact, order status updates, download instructions, password change) in an e-commerce application. The class utilizes template tokens, external services, and constants to compose and send HTML emails asynchronously.

classes.name: EmailTemplatesUtils
classes.description: A utility class providing methods for constructing and sending various email notifications related to orders, registration, contact inquiries, order status updates, downloads, and password changes within an e-commerce system.

methods.name: sendOrderEmail
methods.description: Asynchronously sends an order confirmation email to the customer, including billing/shipping details and order summary.

methods.name: sendRegistrationEmail
methods.description: Sends a welcome email to a new customer after registration, containing login details and access links.

methods.name: sendContactEmail
methods.description: Sends an email to the store's contact address with details submitted via the contact form.

methods.name: sendUpdateOrderStatusEmail
methods.description: Sends an email to the customer updating them on their order status, including comments and status messages.

methods.name: sendOrderDownloadEmail
methods.description: Sends instructions for downloading purchased files to the customer.

methods.name: changePasswordNotificationEmail
methods.description: Notifies the customer that their password has been changed, including the date of change.
